subject: AI 与科技日报 2026-10-26 · Daily AI & Tech Brief
headline_zh: 卢拉赢下巴西第四任期，塞尔维亚武契奇认输；AI 投资回报遭质疑
headline_en: Lula wins Brazil's presidency again, Vucic concedes in Serbia, and an Apollo economist questions AI's payoff

items.title_zh: Apollo 经济学家：AI 对多数企业“零财务回报”
items.title_en: Apollo economist: AI delivers 'zero financial payoff' to most companies
items.body_zh: Apollo 首席经济学家在接受 TechCrunch 采访时说，除了科技行业本身，美国企业界在 AI 上投入巨大却几乎没有看到财务回报。这一判断给当前的基础设施投资热潮泼了冷水。
items.body_en: An Apollo chief economist told TechCrunch that outside the tech sector itself, corporate America has seen essentially no financial return on its heavy AI spending. The verdict lands squarely on the infrastructure boom.

items.title_zh: IBM CEO：开源权重模型已足够好、足够便宜
items.title_en: IBM CEO says open-weight models are now good and cheap on-prem
items.body_zh: IBM CEO 在 The Register 的报道中表示，开源权重模型的质量和成本已经让企业本地部署变得有吸引力。这对依赖闭源 API 收费的厂商是个压力信号。
items.body_en: IBM's CEO argued in remarks reported by The Register that open-weight models are now good and cheap enough to run on-premises. That is a pressure signal for vendors whose business rests on closed API pricing.

items.title_zh: 三星、SK 海力士传 2027Q2 量产 8Hi HBM4 供英伟达
items.title_en: Samsung, SK Hynix reportedly to mass-produce 8Hi HBM4 for Nvidia in Q2 2027
items.body_zh: 韩媒 ZDNET Korea 报道称，两家 DRAM 厂计划 2027 年第二季度全面量产八层堆叠 HBM4 并向英伟达出货。报道说英伟达 2026 年第三季度就此事与两家认真讨论，动机是 Rubin 系列采用 8Hi 方案。
items.body_en: Korean outlet ZDNET Korea reports the two DRAM makers plan full mass production of 8-high HBM4 stacks for Nvidia in Q2 2027. Nvidia reportedly began serious talks with both in Q3 2026, driven by plans to use 8Hi parts in Rubin and Rubin Ultra.

items.title_zh: 软银据报拟在马来西亚投 500 亿美元科技
items.title_en: SoftBank reportedly plans $50B tech investment in Malaysia
items.body_zh: CNBC 报道，软银计划向马来西亚科技领域投入 500 亿美元，后者正把自己定位为“AI 国家”。这是 AI 基础设施资本向东南亚扩散的最新一例。
items.body_en: CNBC reports SoftBank plans a $50 billion tech investment in Malaysia, which is pitching itself as an 'AI nation.' It is the latest sign of AI infrastructure capital spreading across Southeast Asia.

items.title_zh: Anthropic CEO 呼吁加强对 AI 的监管
items.title_en: Anthropic CEO calls for stronger AI regulation
items.body_zh: ABC News 独家报道，Anthropic CEO 公开主张对 AI 施加更严格的监管。头部模型公司主动要求被管，与行业整体的放松监管呼声形成对照。
items.body_en: In an ABC News exclusive, Anthropic's CEO publicly called for stronger regulation of AI. A leading model developer asking to be regulated cuts against the industry's broader push for lighter rules.

items.title_zh: Grok 放出 AI 生成《奥德赛》前七分钟
items.title_en: Grok releases first seven minutes of AI-generated 'Odyssey'
items.body_zh: Grok 发布了 AI 生成影片《奥德赛》的开头七分钟。TechCrunch 的评价是画面尚可，但别指望艺术性或人文趣味。
items.body_en: Grok released the first seven minutes of its AI-generated 'Odyssey.' TechCrunch's read: the footage looks okay, as long as you are not after artistry or human interest.

items.title_zh: iFixit 拆解 iPhone Duo：铰链与屏幕疑为裂屏元凶
items.title_en: iFixit teardown of iPhone Duo points to hinge and screen
items.body_zh: iFixit 拆开苹果首款折叠机 iPhone Duo，给出 5/10 的可维修分，并指出苹果可能如何掩盖折痕。社交平台上大量用户报告铰链卡住后屏幕爆裂，一名 YouTuber 的拆解也指向同一位置。
items.body_en: iFixit tore down Apple's first foldable, the iPhone Duo, scoring it 5/10 for repairability and flagging how Apple may be hiding the crease. Users across social media report the hinge catching and the screen cracking within hours, and a YouTuber's teardown points to the same spot.

items.title_zh: 卢拉赢下巴西大选第四任期，博索纳罗阵营拒认输
items.title_en: Lula wins fourth term in Brazil as Bolsonaro camp refuses to concede
items.body_zh: 左翼的卢拉·达席尔瓦在第二轮投票中击败极右翼参议员弗拉维奥·博索纳罗，第四次当选巴西总统。多国领导人已致贺，博索纳罗阵营拒绝承认结果，当地选举法院下令恢复全部计票信息。
items.body_en: Leftist Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva beat far-right Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in the runoff to win a fourth, non-consecutive term as Brazil's president. World leaders have congratulated him, the Bolsonaro camp refuses to concede, and the electoral court ordered full results restored.

items.title_zh: 武契奇承认败选，塞尔维亚学生运动上台
items.title_en: Vucic concedes defeat as student-led movement wins Serbia
items.body_zh: 执政 12 年的武契奇承认其政党在议会选举中落败，学生主导的“学生名单-学生获胜”宣布胜选。贝尔格莱德出现庆祝场面，接下来外界关注的是这批学生背景的领导人如何执政。
items.body_en: After 12 years in power, Aleksandar Vučić conceded his party lost the parliamentary election to the student-led 'Students Win' movement. Celebrations broke out in Belgrade, and attention now turns to how the student-backed leaders will govern.

items.title_zh: 胡塞武装称袭击沙特输油站与利雅得机场
items.title_en: Houthis claim attacks on Saudi oil stations and Riyadh airport
items.body_zh: 胡塞武装宣称袭击了沙特多处输油泵站和利雅得机场，沙特方面称拦截了来袭目标。以沙特为首的联军表示已摧毁也门叛军的导弹设施，交战烈度明显上升。
items.body_en: The Houthis said they struck Saudi oil pumping stations and Riyadh airport, while Saudi authorities reported intercepting the incoming attacks. The Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed the rebels' missile facilities as fighting escalates.

quick_zh: 越南首座前端晶圆厂进度落后，路透称 2027 年底试产目标恐难实现，Viettel 正与 ASML 谈 DUV 设备。
苏丹快速支援部队用无人机袭击东部五座电站，造成大范围停电。
英国财政大臣 John Healey 将于 10 月 28 日公布预算，拟为低收入养老金领取者减税。
quick_en: Vietnam's first front-end wafer fab is behind schedule; Reuters says a 2027 trial production target looks unlikely, and Viettel is negotiating with ASML for a DUV tool.
Sudan's Rapid Support Forces hit five power stations in the east with drones, causing widespread outages.
UK Chancellor John Healey presents his Budget on 28 October, with plans to shield low-income pensioners from income tax.
